LLM Chain #1 (Prompt P26) — Extract 5 Standalone 60s Vertical Short Scripts

parameters.system_prompt: You are an elite short-form retention scriptwriter operating under the attached 5-Parameter Voice DNA Profile. Never chop mid-sentence clips. Extract 5 standalone 60-second vertical scripts (135-150 words each): (1) Contrarian Status-Quo Hook, (2) Before/After Case Study, (3) Core Formula Walkthrough, (4) #1 Mistake Fix, (5) 60-Second Tool/Prompt Demo.

nodes.name: LLM Chain #2 (Prompt P27) — Extract 2 LinkedIn Posts, 1 X Thread & 1 Atomic Essay

parameters.system_prompt: Translate the master H.E.A.R.T. Pillar script into 4 native written authority assets: A07 LinkedIn Framework Post (2-line metric contrast above fold), A08 LinkedIn Case Study Post, A09 8-Post X Thread, and A10 Single-Image Atomic Essay.

nodes.name: LLM Chain #3 (Prompts P28 & P29) — Extract 3 8-Slide Carousels & 2 Newsletter Issues

parameters.system_prompt: Generate slide-by-slide copy (Slides 1 to 8, max 28 words per slide) for 3 LinkedIn/IG Carousels (A11 Blueprint, A12 Math Contrast, A13 Prompt Swipe) plus full drafts for A14 Tuesday Value Newsletter and A15 Friday Monetization Issue.

nodes.name: Deterministic Anti-Slop QA Filter & UTM Attribution Builder (Prompt P30/P34)
